name: Kathleen Walsh
brief_description: a young woman with a baby on her hip

home.name: The Boatman's Cottage
home.description: A small thatched cottage perched above the waterline, with nets drying on a stone wall and a currach pulled up on the shingle. The smell of turf smoke and fish mingles in the air. It is daylight. The lake stretches away under the weather sky.

workplace.name: The Boatman's Cottage
workplace.description: A small thatched cottage perched above the waterline, with nets drying on a stone wall and a currach pulled up on the shingle. The smell of turf smoke and fish mingles in the air. It is daylight. The lake stretches away under the weather sky.

source_personality_summary: A practical, warm-hearted young woman who keeps the boatman's cottage together.
source_knowledge: Knows Eamon's smuggling routes and worries every time he goes out at night.
Her family in Curraghboy says the land agent there has started evicting tenants.
Knows dozens of old songs in Irish that her grandmother taught her.
Noticed Martin Concannon asking questions about boats at the bay.

source_schedule_cues.activity: at the crossroads after Mass, chatting with the other women
at Mass with Eamon and Ciaran
down at the bay, washing clothes in the shallows, watching for Eamon's boat
walking to Connolly's Shop for supplies, Ciaran in tow
visiting Una Malone at the weaver's cottage, singing songs together
dinner at the cottage with Ciaran
household work — washing, cleaning, tending the garden
preparing supper, mending nets, singing to Ciaran
putting Ciaran to bed, waiting for Eamon to come home
rising, feeding Ciaran, making breakfast, seeing Eamon off
